title: VbyF Controller
text: Implement V/F (open-loop or scalar) control for three-phase motors, 7 inputs, 1 output, {Input speed unit} sets Unit of the speed inputs; {Per unit speed (RPM)} sets the base speed of the motor and {Discrete step size (s) (-1 for inherit)} sets the sample time after which block executes again. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: N pp
ports.summary: Number of motor pole pairs scalar

ports.name: V rated
ports.summary: Rated phase voltage amplitude of motor scalar

ports.name: N Ramp
ports.summary: Steps for initial ramp up scalar

params.name: Input speed unit
params.values: Unit of the speed inputs Radians/Sec (default) | RPM | Degrees/Sec | Per unit based on dialog

params.name: Per unit speed (RPM)
params.values: Base speed of the motor (RPM) 1200 (default) | scalar

params.name: Discrete step size (s) (-1 for inherit)
params.values: Sample time after which block executes again 50e-6 (default) | scalar
